item.title: Singapore: New Research Lab Strengthens Energy Tech Leadership
item.description: Singapore has launched a research lab to accelerate next-generation well completion technologies, strengthen energy innovation and develop talent for sustainable energy operations.

item.title: Australia: Shaping Queensland’s Science and Innovation Future
item.description: Queensland has launched public consultation on a statewide science and innovation strategy aimed at boosting research capability, fostering collaboration and translating technology into long-term economic and social impact.

item.title: The Philippines: ATI‑RTC‑10 Marks Milestone in AI, Digital Farming
item.description: ATI‑RTC‑10 marks its 39th anniversary by advancing digital and AI-driven farming, empowering Northern Mindanao farmers with technology, training and tools to boost productivity, efficiency and sustainability.

item.title: Hong Kong: Joint Lab to Advance High-Efficiency AI Computing
item.description: HKUST has launched a joint laboratory to research near-memory computing architectures aimed at improving AI performance and energy efficiency.

item.title: Vietnam: Legal Frameworks Boost Technology, Foster Innovation
item.description: Vietnam is modernising its legal framework to streamline technology transfer, foster domestic and foreign innovation partnerships and create a transparent, investment-friendly environment for sustainable economic growth.

item.title: Singapore: TradeTrust Drives Global Digital Trade Transformation
item.description: Singapore launched the TradeTrust Readiness Programme to accelerate interoperable electronic trade documents in maritime shipping, backed by insurance approvals, platform adoption and a growing global ecosystem.

item.title: The Philippines: Advancing Digital Competence Nationwide
item.description: These key upskilling initiatives in Mindoro and Aurora are equipping families and government employees with essential digital skills to improve financial resilience, workplace efficiency and secure online practices.

item.title: Hong Kong: Joint Centre to Advance Healthy Ageing, Smart Care
item.description: Hong Kong Polytechnic University and the University of Toronto have partnered to advance research in healthy ageing and AgeTech, developing health, rehabilitation and assistive solutions for ageing populations.

item.title: Vietnam’s First National Supercomputer Powers AI Innovation
item.description: Vietnam has launched its first national supercomputer, boosting domestic AI capabilities, supporting large-scale model development and advancing the country’s digital transformation and innovation ambitions.

item.title: Singapore: Hands-On Training to Strengthen Public Digital Resilience
item.description: Singapore is piloting the National Simulated Scams Exercise to empower all citizens, especially the elderly, to recognise, respond to and protect themselves against evolving online and digital scams.
